<section>
<markdown>### Example: orders and customers

`SELECT orders.id, customers.name FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id` pairs each order with its customer.</markdown>
<mermaid>graph LR; O[Order 7] --> C[Customer Ana]</mermaid>

</section>
<section>
<markdown>### Analogy

Think of a join like matching name tags to seats: each tag (foreign key) points to exactly one seat (primary key).</markdown>
